articles.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
articles.description: Martial law has been in place in Ukraine since February 2022, under which elections are suspended.

articles.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
articles.description: It comes after Trump announced plans to curtail joint military exercises with South Korea, citing a "very good" relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.

articles.title: Asylum seekers warned not to make 'kissing sounds' at people in new guidance about living in UK
articles.description: A guide for asylum seekers published by the Home Office has told them not to rape or sexually harass people, including partners and children.
